name: Interpump Group S.p.A.
summary: Interpump Group S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and selling of high-pressure pumps in Italy, rest of Europe, North America, the Far East and the Pacific Area, and internationally. The company is involved in the design and distribution of volumetric pumps; production, sale, and distribution of pressure systems and pumps; production of mechanical sifters; production and sale of equipment for the food processing, chemicals, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals industries; galvanic treatment of metals; and sale of centrifugal separators.
